description: This file defines the ProductMixHelper class used for interacting with product mix related API endpoints in the Apache Fineract project. It includes methods to retrieve product mix lists and templates, utilizing REST API calls, and contains deprecated methods suggesting future refactoring plans.

classes.name: ProductMixHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing methods for retrieving product mix data from the Fineract API, designed for integration testing purposes.

methods.name: ProductMixHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the helper with request and response specifications.

methods.name: getProductsMixList
methods.description: Fetches the list of product mixes from the server.

methods.name: getProductMixTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template for creating or updating product mixes from the server.
